Workspace per FB-RAT-WS-001: the top-level durable object the Workspace Kernel is authoritative for (projects, files, buffers, indexes, tasks, language sessions, launch state, recovery). Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<Workspace> (see schemas/common/envelope.schema.json), inheriting schemaVersion/objectId/createdAtUtc/producer from that outer envelope where one wraps it; `workspaceId` below is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID, independent of `displayName`.
title: Workspace

workspaceId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this workspace (FB-RAT-COM-002), independent of `displayName` — renaming a workspace MUST NOT change this.

displayName.description: Human-legible workspace name. Display-only; never an identity key.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant this workspace was created (FB-RAT-COM-004).

projectIds.description: Stable `Project.projectId` values this workspace contains (FB-RAT-WS-001 — the kernel is authoritative for projects). Membership order carries no meaning.

activeProjectId.description: The currently-focused project, when one is focused. SHOULD be a member of `projectIds` — not structurally enforced here (JSON Schema 2020-12 has no cross-array-membership keyword without a `$data` extension, which this constellation does not depend on); a reader MUST treat an `activeProjectId` absent from `projectIds` as a data-integrity fault, not silently ignore it.

providerConnections.description: Live connection state for each configured WorkspaceProvider this workspace uses (WorkspaceProviderState machine — see WORKSPACE_KERNEL_SPEC.md §6). One entry per distinct `providerId`; `providerId` values SHOULD be unique within this array.

providerId.description: Stable ID of the configured provider connection (e.g. a specific SSH host config's ID, or a fixed literal like 'local-primary' for the on-device filesystem provider).

providerKind.description: Same closed vocabulary as ResourceUri.provider (FB-RAT-WS-002) — the provider family this connection belongs to.

state.description: Current WorkspaceProviderState (WORKSPACE_KERNEL_SPEC.md §6 transition table): UNCONFIGURED -> CONNECTING -> READY <-> DEGRADED -> DISCONNECTED | AUTH_REQUIRED | FAILED.

lastTransitionAtUtc.description: UTC instant of the most recent state transition (FB-RAT-COM-004).

detail.description: Optional plain-language detail for the current state (FB-RAT-COM-009 — textual semantics for a non-READY connection state, so degraded/disconnected/auth-required/failed is legible without relying on a color-only status dot).

recoverySnapshotId.description: The most recent `RecoverySnapshot.snapshotId` checkpointed for this workspace (FB-RAT-WS-003), or null if none has been taken yet.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).
